tenders.title: Saudi Cargo representation Benelux
requirements: Named forwarder account pipeline across AMS, BRU and LGG
Weekly pipeline and route performance reporting
tenders.commercialExpectations: Saudia Cargo is looking for a Benelux GSA with strong pharma and e-commerce account access, active sales coverage in Amsterdam, Brussels and Liege, and the ability to grow both freighter and belly cargo flows into JED and RUH.

tenders.title: Saudi Cargo UK and Ireland sales mandate
requirements: UK and Ireland field sales coverage
Experience with express, mail and e-commerce cargo
Local customer service desk with airline handover process
Monthly sales forecast and key account conversion report
tenders.commercialExpectations: The selected GSA should build a focused sales pipeline for UK and Ireland forwarders, prioritize high-yield express and e-commerce traffic, and support a structured launch plan for LHR, MAN and DUB origin cargo.

tenders.title: Saudi Cargo France representation
tenders.productMix: Pharma, luxury goods, perishables, general cargo

applications.proposedCommission: 5% on net-net revenue, plus 2% incentive for exceeding tonnage targets.
applications.launchTimeline: Ready for full operational takeoff within 45 days of contract signature.
applications.namedAccountCoverage: Direct access to 15 Tier-1 forwarders and 40+ specialized SME accounts in the DACH region.
applications.monthlySalesTarget: Initial target of 1,500 tons per month with a 10% MoM growth projection.
applications.networkPlan: Our strategy focuses on a 'Hub-and-Spoke' approach. We will utilize our existing sales offices in Frankfurt (FRA), Munich (MUC), and Zurich (ZRH) to feed cargo into Saudia’s main gateways. We plan daily feeder services and a dedicated trucking network (RFS) to ensure 24/7 connectivity to the JED and RUH hubs. Special focus will be placed on high-yield lanes originating from the German automotive and chemical sectors.
applications.operationalReadiness: We are fully IATA/CASS certified and currently employ a team of 12 dedicated cargo sales professionals. Our IT infrastructure is ready for seamless EDI integration with Saudia Cargo’s systems. We have existing SLA agreements with major Ground Handling Agents (GHA) in all major German airports, ensuring immediate cargo acceptance and processing capabilities upon launch.
